income_forms.fit: Project work pays for the finished object, which is exactly where your energy already runs. A brief arrives, you go quiet, sit down, and return with the thing working — the same loop you use to discharge pressure becomes the thing that carries a price tag. In a project shape, the person who watches you deliver can also be the one who pays, which wires the return end your chart does not build on its own.
income_forms.friction: The friction is not the work, it is the terms. You will deliver ahead of schedule and then accept whatever number was written at the start, even when scope doubled. Someone else prices the middle. You need one clause habit: when scope changes, the price conversation happens before the extra work, not after.
income_forms.evidence: Eating God is the heaviest force in the chart — the month stem Xin, with hidden Xin in the day branch You and the year branch Chou — and it is precisely the god of finished output. Wealth in the chart is nearly absent: Indirect Wealth carries a trace through hidden Gui in the year branch Chou, and Direct Wealth is missing entirely, while water, the element that carries money for a Ji earth day master, does not appear among the visible characters. So income does not flow to you incidentally; it has to be structurally attached to what you make, which project pricing does.

income_forms.fit: Consulting converts your method layer into paid conversation: you sit with a hard problem someone else cannot metabolize, break it into steps, and hand back a structure. This uses the Direct Resource buffer — the pressure comes in, you convert it to method — and it pays for judgment rather than volume, which protects your maker blocks.
income_forms.friction: You diagnose well but sell poorly. When the client asks your rate, the peer-mode reflex says keep it friendly and equal; you will underquote to avoid the negotiation moment. Consulting also tempts you into infinite scope — a peer who keeps asking becomes a friend you keep helping.
income_forms.evidence: Direct Resource holds solid weight — hidden Bing fire in both Snake branches, the month and hour — and it is the classic metabolizer of the year stem Yi, which stands as Seven Killings, the incoming pressure. The strong Ji earth self, marked slightly abundant, holds load well, so being paid to absorb and structure other people's pressure matches the wiring. But Companion nearly ties Eating God for heaviest — the hour stem Ji mirrors you, with hidden Ji in Chou and hidden Wu in both Snake branches — so peer-mode pricing, the friendly discount, is your standing leak in any client relationship.

income_forms.fit: Content is craft output that keeps earning after you finish it: a course, a documented method, a demonstration series. It matches your teaching-by-demonstrating reflex — you cook the meal on camera rather than describe cooking. One made thing, many deliveries, which partially solves the absent return channel.
income_forms.friction: The stuck point is packaging and pricing. You will happily produce the material and then leave it free or unlisted, because charging requires the exact conversation your chart never initiates. Content also demands you talk about yourself, which the equal-among-peers mode resists.
income_forms.evidence: The same Eating God weight that powers projects powers content — the month stem Xin flanked by hidden Xin underfoot. The Direct Resource layer from both Snake branches gives the material a method backbone, so the content tends toward durable how-to rather than opinion. But with water absent from the visible chart and Direct Wealth at nothing, monetization is the missing organ: production is native, distribution-to-payment is not, and the useful-god list naming water means the money channel is the one the chart itself asks you to build deliberately.

income_forms.fit: Salary gives you the thing you struggle to generate alone: a stable container where demands arrive pre-priced and you never negotiate. For your current stage — middle income, some savings, no property — it is a defensible floor, and inside a small team of equals it can even feel good.
income_forms.friction: A flat salary pays for elapsed presence and lets demand grow without the price moving. You will absorb the extra hard task because absorbing is effortless for you, and the year-end conversation about title or raise is the one meeting you quietly skip. Salary rewards the channel you lack and taxes the one you run hardest.
income_forms.evidence: The year stem Yi as Seven Killings means pressure arrives from outside regardless of pay structure, and with Companion and Eating God jointly heaviest, your reflex under load is to take the task personally and deliver — the hour stem Ji, your mirror, picks it up. Direct Officer is missing entirely, so the formal hierarchy channel that would otherwise carry promotion runs on nothing; advancement under salary must be forced by you, and the current luck stretch, the pillar beginning in the early thirties with Ding fire on Chou earth, thickens the self further rather than opening the money flow.

income_forms.fit: Equity has one real attraction for you: it converts peer trust into deferred ownership. In a small team of equals who each own a craft, holding a share means the person who watches you deliver is contractually the person who must pay you later — it wires the return end structurally.
income_forms.friction: The risks sit exactly on your weak channel. Equity requires reading terms, valuing your contribution against louder co-founders, and renegotiating when the shape changes — all Wealth-and-terms activity. You will sign the friendly version and discover the mismatch years later.
income_forms.evidence: With Companion weighted almost as heavily as Eating God, you operate in equals-and-craft territory, and the hidden Gui water inside the year branch Chou is a thin thread of Indirect Wealth — windfall-style, buried, requiring excavation. The luck pillars from the early forties onward finally run water branches — the pillar with Zi, then the one with Hai — which is when ownership conversations and value-claiming feel less foreign; before that stretch, equity decisions need an external equal or a licensed professional reading the terms beside you.

income_forms.fit: Pure market investing is the one form that runs entirely on the channel you do not have. It rewards reading flow, timing entries and exits, and cutting losses against emotion — decisions about moving value, not making objects. As a secondary place to park what craft earns, it can sit quietly; as a primary income form it mismatches your wiring.
income_forms.friction: Your pressure-absorption loop works against you here: when a position goes bad, your instinct is to hold the load quietly and outlast it, the way you outlast a hard requirement. Markets do not reward being the last one standing. Impulse leaks are also structural — the trace of Indirect Wealth invites occasional bets on the interesting thing.
income_forms.evidence: Water, your wealth element for a Ji earth day master, is absent from the visible characters, and Direct Wealth sits at nothing while Indirect Wealth holds only a trace — hidden Gui in the year branch Chou. Investing as income asks the empty channel to carry the whole load. Your stated preference for balanced, medium risk fits: keep investing small, rule-based, and boring, and let the heavy channels — Eating God output and Companion trust — do the earning.

leaks.how_it_shows: A capable friend proposes something together; you agree on a handshake, do the building half, and never revisit who owns what. Because delivering is effortless and renegotiating is not, two years later the asset you built is legally theirs and you feel awkward raising it.
leaks.rule: If a collaboration will produce anything that outlives the month, then before the first day of work there is one written page — ownership split, exit clause — and each side signs it; no page, no start.

leaks.how_it_shows: Peers learn that handing you the hard task works, so the favors accumulate: you fix the colleague's piece, cover a friend's delivery, review someone's work free. Each is small; together they eat the maker blocks that are your actual income engine. You say yes in peer mode before price ever enters the room.
leaks.rule: If a request from a non-paying party will take more than one maker block, then it gets a counter-offer — a swap, a fee, or a polite no — delivered within twenty-four hours; silence counts as yes only for paid work.

leaks.how_it_shows: The thin thread of Indirect Wealth shows up as occasional attraction to the interesting, clever opportunity — a side bet, a friend's venture, a novel tool. You research it deeply because deep-diving is your mode, then commit at the wrong moment and, when it sours, hold quietly rather than exit, because outlasting is your signature move with demands.
leaks.rule: If you feel the pull toward a new commitment of money, then it waits one full week on a written one-pager, and if after the week it is down, the exit rule you wrote on day one executes without renegotiation.

leaks.how_it_shows: Risk does not leak through recklessness but through concentration plus silence: all earnings ride one skill, one team, one income form, and no one checks the terms. Because the chart never prompts the quarterly terms review, exposure builds invisibly until a contract, client, or role changes underneath you.
leaks.rule: If one client or one employer supplies most of your income, then each quarter you spend one named calendar slot counting that share and taking one concrete step — a second client conversation, a published piece — to lower it before the next review.

conservative.name: Salaried floor plus priced side craft
conservative.mechanics: Keep the salary as container, and alongside it run a small project or consulting line priced per delivered object, not per hour. Every quarter, one named slot reviews whether the last cycle of work converted into anything banked. Savings ride boring, rule-based vehicles chosen with a licensed professional.
conservative.preconditions: You have a stable role inside a small team of equals with direct access to the decision-maker; the side line stays under the volume where it invades your maker blocks; and the quarterly calendar entry actually exists and is kept.

balanced.name: Project-and-content double engine
balanced.mechanics: Shift the center of gravity from salary to project and consulting income attached to finished objects, while converting the same craft into durable content — a documented method, a demonstration series — that keeps reaching people after delivery. One repeated terms-clause habit: scope change triggers price talk before extra work. A modest, rule-based investing sleeve matches your stated balanced preference.
balanced.preconditions: You already have repeat clients or an employer flexible enough to reduce hours; the terms conversation has become a written habit rather than a mood-dependent one; and the water-branch luck stretch from the early forties — the pillar carrying the Rat — has begun, making price and ownership talk feel less foreign.

aggressive.name: Craft venture with written ownership
aggressive.mechanics: Build a productized service or small studio with one or two equals who each own a craft, short vertical, direct access to whoever pays. Take equity in your own venture rather than someone else's, with the ownership page signed on day one. Content becomes the distribution engine for the product.
aggressive.preconditions: A genuine pool of demand you have personally served at project rates first; one equal who handles or co-signs all terms and negotiation so nothing is priced by default; a cash runway that covers the maker without panic; and ideally entry inside the water decades of the luck cycle, the pillars from the early forties to early sixties, where the flow your chart lacks runs strongest from outside.

asset_ideas.idea: A productized repair-and-improve service: clients hand you a broken system, template, workshop, or kitchen process; you return it working, at a fixed per-object price published openly.
asset_ideas.uses_talent: This is your core loop verbatim — rough brief in, working version out, no mood or perfect conditions needed. The fixed published price externalizes the negotiation your chart will never start spontaneously.
asset_ideas.fits_life_structure: Short vertical — one decision-maker per client, no layers; craft feedback arrives within days when the thing runs, feeding your fast clock; the slow clock is handled by the published price itself, which banks terms automatically.
asset_ideas.startup_cost: Low — tools you already own, one page stating the objects and prices, and the discipline to point referrals at that page instead of quoting by chat.
asset_ideas.likely_blocker: The pricing page itself. You will build ten excellent objects before you write one honest price list; expect the blocker at publication, not production.

asset_ideas.idea: A demonstration-based method course: one recorded series where you do the thing on camera — the repair, the build, the teaching-by-showing — packaged so each lesson ends with a finished artifact, sold as a durable product.
asset_ideas.uses_talent: Eating God output plus the Direct Resource method backbone from both Snake branches: the material tends toward durable how-to with steps, which is exactly what outlasts trends. You teach by demonstrating rather than lecturing, so the format matches the reflex.
asset_ideas.fits_life_structure: One made thing, many deliveries — it partially solves the absent return channel. Maker blocks are protected: recording is a maker block. Content earns between projects without consuming peer trust.
asset_ideas.startup_cost: Low to moderate — a recording setup, editing time carved from maker blocks, and a simple storefront chosen with care rather than platform-chasing.
asset_ideas.likely_blocker: Self-presentation. The peer-mode reflex resists being the visible expert; the workaround is staying behind the object — the camera watches the work, not you.

asset_ideas.idea: A craft-equal studio with written shares: two or three peers, each owning a craft, one shared brand, ownership and exit terms signed before the first joint project, with roles split so someone else carries the terms conversation.
asset_ideas.uses_talent: Companion and Eating God jointly heaviest means equals-and-craft is your native operating mode — deep trust flows back to you there at zero effort, and the studio lets that trust become structure rather than informal favors.
asset_ideas.fits_life_structure: Dense horizontal, short vertical by design: the team shape and the client shape are the same shape. The signed page is the quarterly terms check made permanent instead of repeated.
asset_ideas.startup_cost: Moderate — a shared entity, legal drafting best done with a licensed professional, and several months of runway while the first joint project lands.
asset_ideas.likely_blocker: The renegotiation moment. When the venture's shape changes — a member leaves, a client doubles — your instinct is to absorb quietly. The countermeasure is a standing external reviewer: a named equal or professional who must re-read the terms at every change, so the check does not depend on you initiating it.

disclaimer: This analysis reads only the fit between your chart's energy distribution — the heavy output and peer channels, the thin wealth and hierarchy channels, and the timing of the luck pillars — and different income shapes. It is self-knowledge, not investment advice, and nothing here predicts market movement, returns, or outcomes. For contracts, equity, taxes, entity formation, or any major financial decision, consult a licensed professional; for the terms your chart will never spontaneously negotiate, treat that professional as part of your structure, not an accessory.
